name: @zlink-systems/zlink
description: zlink Node.js bindings — high-performance async messaging library
author: Zlink Systems

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && ln -sfn ../dist dist-tools/dist && npm run build:codecs
scripts.build:codecs: npm --prefix packages/zlink-codec-json run build && npm --prefix packages/zlink-codec-messagepack run build && npm --prefix packages/zlink-codec-protobuf run build
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run rebuild-native
scripts.test:codecs: node packages/zlink-codec-json/test.mjs && node packages/zlink-codec-messagepack/test.mjs && node packages/zlink-codec-protobuf/test.mjs
scripts.presamples: npm run build && npm run rebuild-native
